title: Something Escapes the Lab
summary: An unseen creature breaks free from a corridor in Hawkins Lab. A scientist is dragged into the darkness. Eleven flees into the night.

title: Benny Finds a Girl
summary: Eleven breaks into Benny's Burgers, ravenous. Benny Hammond finds her eating fries and tries to help — calling Social Services. She doesn't understand.

title: Will Vanishes
summary: Cycling home through Mirkwood, Will encounters something terrifying. His bike is found abandoned. Will is gone.

title: The Demogorgon Campaign
summary: The Party's D&D campaign reaches its climax in the Wheeler basement. Will rolls a 7 — the Demogorgon attacks. The game ends. Will bikes home alone into the dark.

title: A Girl in the Rain
summary: Searching for Will in the rain, the Party finds a terrified, shaved-head girl wearing a hospital gown. She shows them the number tattooed on her wrist: 011.

title: Eleven Hides at the Wheelers
summary: Mike sneaks Eleven into his basement. She sleeps in the fort, discovers the TV set, and begins to trust Mike. The hunt for Will intensifies.

title: Benny Is Silenced
summary: A woman from Social Services arrives — but she's an agent from Hawkins Lab. Benny is shot. Eleven uses her power to kill the agents and escapes again.

title: Joyce Hears Will
summary: The phone rings — and Will is on the line, his voice distorted and terrified. Before Joyce can speak, the phone melts from the heat of the call.

title: Barb Is Taken
summary: Left alone at the Harrington pool, Barb Holland is dragged through a portal by the Demogorgon. She is never seen alive again.

title: Joyce Investigates the Lights
summary: The lights in the Byers house flicker and surge. Joyce follows them down the hallway — something is in the walls. She tears at the wallpaper. A face pushes through.

title: The Christmas Lights Alphabet
summary: Joyce strings Christmas lights across the living room wall and paints letters. The lights flash — Will is spelling out a word. He is alive.

title: A Body in the Quarry
summary: A body is recovered from Sattler Quarry. The town believes Will is dead. Joyce refuses to accept it — she can still feel him.

title: Hopper Suspects the Lab
summary: The autopsy doesn't add up. Hopper traces the evidence back to Hawkins Lab and a classified project called MKUltra.

title: Joyce Refuses to Believe
summary: The town holds a funeral for Will. Joyce stands alone in her conviction: that is not her son. She can still feel him. The town thinks she's lost her mind.

title: The Flea and the Acrobat
summary: Mr. Clarke explains theoretical dimensions. Eleven demonstrates the Upside Down using a folded piece of paper — a dimension parallel to ours, dark and decaying.

title: The Boys Search for the Gate
summary: Armed with compasses, the boys search Mirkwood for the Gate. Lucas and Mike fight over Eleven's trust. The compasses spin wildly — then suddenly agree on a direction.

title: Compasses Point to the Gate
summary: All compasses in Mirkwood spin wildly, pointing toward the Gate. Eleven secretly redirects them, afraid of what they might find.

title: Hopper Infiltrates the Lab
summary: Hopper breaks into the lab and finds a portal to a dark mirror world. Vines creep the walls. He barely escapes before agents catch him.

title: Eleven's Truth
summary: Mike discovers Eleven has been keeping secrets. She confesses: she made contact with the Demogorgon. She opened the Gate. It's all her fault.

title: Lucas Returns
summary: Lucas returns after witnessing Eleven's power firsthand. He apologizes. The Party is whole again — and they realize Eleven may be the only one who can find Will.

title: Eleven Shows Her Power
summary: In Mike's basement, Eleven flips a game board with her mind to prove what she can do. The boys stare in awe. She points at the wall: Will is on the other side.

title: The Bathtub
summary: The Party floods the school gym with Epsom salt to recreate Eleven's sensory deprivation tank. She enters the Void — and finds Will. He is hiding in Castle Byers.

title: Searching the Tunnels
summary: Hopper and Joyce enter the Gate and descend into the Upside Down's tunnels beneath Hawkins Lab. The walls pulse with tendrils. They follow the vines deeper.

title: Hopper's Deal
summary: Hopper cuts a deal with Dr. Brenner: give up Joyce and Jonathan's location in exchange for safe passage through the Gate to find Will.

title: Something in the Woods
summary: In the woods near the Byers house, something moves through the trees. A deer carcass is found torn apart. The Demogorgon is hunting — and it's getting closer.

title: Into the Upside Down
summary: Joyce and Hopper suit up and step through the Gate at Hawkins Lab into the Upside Down — a suffocating mirror of the real world, choked with spores.

title: The Demogorgon Attacks
summary: The Demogorgon tears through the wall of the school classroom. As it advances on the Party, Eleven stands between them — this is her choice.

title: Eleven's Sacrifice
summary: Eleven disintegrates the Demogorgon with all her remaining power. In doing so, she disintegrates herself — vanishing with a soft 'Goodbye, Mike.'

title: Will Comes Home
summary: Joyce and Hopper find Will wrapped in vines in the Upside Down. He is resuscitated. He comes home. The Byers house is full of light.

title: One Month Later
summary: Will has nightmares. Hopper leaves food in a box in the woods. Joyce watches her son eat dinner, grateful. In the dark, something stirs.

title: The Madmax Score
summary: A mysterious player called MADMAX beats Dustin's high score at the arcade. The Party is stunned — then a new girl walks into class.

title: The Shadow Monster
summary: Trick-or-treating near the pumpkin patch, Will is pulled into a vision. A massive spider-like shadow looms over Hawkins. He can't move. He can't scream.

title: The New Girl
summary: Max Mayfield arrives at Hawkins Middle. She's fierce, she's fearless, and she's about to shake up the Party. Lucas and Dustin are both smitten.

title: Halloween Night
summary: The Party dresses up for Halloween. Will keeps having episodes — brief flashes of the shadow monster. The others don't notice. He's alone with the visions.

title: Will Pulled Under
summary: The shadow monster pulls Will fully into the Upside Down vision. He sees the creature extend its tendrils into Hawkins. When he snaps back, he's freezing cold.

title: Eleven in Hiding
summary: Flashback: Hopper has been hiding Eleven in his cabin for almost a year. She watches soap operas, practices her powers, and waits. She's going stir-crazy.

title: Dart
summary: Dustin finds a strange creature in the trash at school. He names it Dart. It's cute, it purrs, and it's definitely not from this dimension.

title: The Tunnel Map
summary: Will draws page after page of strange lines. Joyce realizes they're a map — the shadow monster is showing Will the Upside Down tunnels spreading beneath Hawkins.

title: Dart Escapes
summary: Dart molts — growing larger, sprouting a face-splitting maw. He escapes from the science class terrarium. Dustin realizes with horror: it's a baby Demogorgon.

title: Taken Over
summary: Will collapses. His body temperature plummets. When he wakes, something is different — he's cold, distant, speaking in a voice that isn't quite his own.

title: Something Else Is Here
summary: Joyce lights candles around Will. He recoils from the heat. She realizes: the thing inside Will is afraid of warmth. Her son is still in there — but something else is, too.

title: Bob Figures It Out
summary: Bob Newby looks at Will's drawings and sees it: they're a map. He helps the group understand the tunnel network spreading beneath the town like roots.

title: Hopper in the Tunnels
summary: Hopper descends into the tunnels to burn them. The flamethrower works — until it doesn't. Vines wrap around his legs. He's trapped underground, alone.

title: Eleven Opens the Rift
summary: From the cabin, Eleven senses Hopper is in danger. She channels all her power and tears open a rift in the tunnels. Hopper crawls through to safety.

title: Will Speaks for the Shadow
summary: Under the Mind Flayer's control, Will feeds Dr. Owens false information about the tunnels. He's become the shadow monster's spy inside the group.

title: The Ambush
summary: The kids set a trap for Dart at the junkyard. Instead, Demodogs swarm them. Steve Harrington fights them off with a baseball bat, protecting the kids.

title: The Tape
summary: Nancy and Jonathan bring the recorded confession to Murray Bauman. Together, they craft a plan to expose Hawkins Lab to the world.

title: Eight
summary: Eleven finds Kali Prasad — Eight — in Chicago. She has the power to create illusions. She's angry, dangerous, and everything Eleven might become.

title: Learning to Channel Anger
summary: Kali teaches Eleven to focus on anger and pain to amplify her powers. It works — Eleven's abilities grow stronger. But at what cost?

title: Eleven Chooses Hawkins
summary: Seeing a photo of Mike and Hopper, Eleven realizes where she belongs. She leaves Kali's gang and heads back to Hawkins. Her friends need her.

title: The Lab Falls
summary: Demodogs breach the lab. Alarms blare. Bob volunteers to reboot the mainframe so the group can escape through the lockdown doors.

title: Bob's Last Stand
summary: Bob reboots the system. The doors open. He smiles at Joyce — and the Demodogs take him down. He bought them their lives with his own.

title: The Heat Plan
summary: Joyce, Jonathan, and Nancy use heat to force the Mind Flayer out of Will. His body convulses. The shadow creature erupts from his mouth and crashes through the ceiling.

title: Closing the Gate
summary: Eleven stands before the Gate. She screams. The rift shrinks, sealing inch by inch. Above, the Demodogs collapse. Below, the Mind Flayer roars in rage.

title: The Gate Is Sealed
summary: The Gate closes with a thunderous boom. The tunnels seal. The Upside Down is cut off — for now. Eleven collapses, exhausted. Hopper catches her.

title: The Snow Ball
summary: The Hawkins Middle Snow Ball dance. Mike and Eleven share a slow dance. Dustin gets turned down by every girl — then Nancy dances with him. For one night, everything is normal.

title: The Truth About Terry
summary: Eleven hacks into Hopper's radio and discovers he's been hiding the truth about her mother. She finds files about Terry Ives. The betrayal cuts deep.

title: Dustin Seeks Help
summary: Dustin tries to get the Party to help with Dart, but no one believes him. He turns to the one person who might understand — Steve Harrington.

title: Demodogs Swarm the Lab
summary: Dozens of Demodogs pour into the lab through the vents. Scientists scatter. The facility that once held the Gate is now overrun by its creatures.

title: The Mind Flayer Watches
summary: At the Snow Ball, Will blinks — and for a flash, he's back in the Upside Down. The Mind Flayer still looms over Hawkins. The Gate is closed, but the monster waits.

title: The Rats
summary: Hawkins rats swarm into the steelworks and explode, their bodies melting into a writhing mass. Something ancient is rebuilding itself.

title: Scoops Ahoy
summary: Steve Harrington and Robin Buckley work the counter at Scoops Ahoy. Robin is bored, witty, and way too smart for this job.

title: The Russian Signal
summary: Dustin intercepts a coded Russian transmission on his radio. No one believes him — except Steve and Robin, who hear it too.

title: Summer Romance
summary: Mike and Eleven are inseparable — and driving Hopper crazy. He tries to have 'the talk' with them, but they won't stop kissing.

title: Hopper's Frustration
summary: Hopper vents to Joyce about Mike and Eleven. Their chemistry is effortless — a reminder of what he lost. Joyce suggests he write a letter.

title: Magnets Stop Working
summary: Joyce's fridge magnets fall off. She investigates — something is interfering with electromagnetic fields in Hawkins. It's happening again.

title: Billy at the Lake
summary: Billy sees something at Lovers Lake. A flash of light, a woman's scream — then nothing. He drives away, but something has changed inside him.

title: Billy Is Taken
summary: The Mind Flayer takes Billy as its host. His eyes darken, his veins blacken. He begins collecting people — luring them to the steelworks to be consumed.

title: Max Knows Something's Wrong
summary: Max notices Billy acting stranger than usual. She's seen his dark side before — but this is different. He's not just angry. He's empty.

title: The Sauna Test
summary: The kids trap Billy in the school sauna. The heat forces the Mind Flayer to surface — Billy's eyes go black, his strength multiplies. He nearly kills Eleven.

title: The Flayed Converge
summary: Billy delivers more people to the steelworks. They drink a strange chemical and melt — their bodies joining the growing mass. The Mind Flayer is building.

title: Into the Base
summary: Steve, Robin, Dustin, and Erica sneak into the Russian base through the mall's elevator shaft. They discover a massive operation — the Russians are opening a gate.

title: Alexei Talks
summary: Hopper and Joyce bring the Russian scientist Alexei to Murray's bunker. After initial resistance, Alexei explains: the Key opens a door to the Upside Down.

title: The Monster Attacks
summary: The Mind Flayer, now fully formed, attacks the kids at the steelworks. Eleven fights it — but it bites her leg, injecting a piece of itself.

title: Eleven's Powers Fade
summary: The bite from the Mind Flayer is spreading. Eleven's powers weaken — she can't move objects, can't reach into the Void. She's vulnerable for the first time.

title: We'll Kill You All
summary: The Mind Flayer speaks through Billy at the steelworks: 'You built the Gate. You opened it. And now we're going to kill you all.'

title: The Fourth of July
summary: The fair at Starcourt Mall. Fireworks, cotton candy, and underneath it all — a Russian machine tearing reality apart.

title: Alexei's Last Firework
summary: Alexei watches the fireworks with wonder — his first American celebration. Then a gunshot. He falls into Murray's arms. He never sees the grand finale.

title: The Battle Begins
summary: The Mind Flayer crashes through the mall. Joyce and Hopper head for the Key. The kids fight for their lives in the food court.

title: Hopper vs. Grigori
summary: Hopper fights Grigori on the platform above the Key. Brutal, desperate, close-quarters — Hopper is outmatched but refuses to quit.

title: Shut It Down
summary: Joyce turns the keys. The Key explodes. Hopper is caught in the blast — standing in front of the gate as it collapses. He's gone.

title: The Mind Flayer Collapses
summary: With the gate closed, the Mind Flayer's body loses its anchor. It collapses in the mall parking lot. But Eleven's wound remains.

title: The Letter
summary: The Byers family packs to leave Hawkins. Joyce hands Eleven a letter Hopper wrote but never gave her. As she reads it, we hear his voice: 'Keep growing up. I'll be right there.'

title: The Hellfire Club
summary: Eddie Munson leads a tense D&D campaign as the Hellfire Club's dungeon master. Dustin and Mike are fully immersed. The school's social lines are drawn: freaks vs. jocks.

title: Chrissy Sees the Clock
summary: Cheerleader Chrissy Maxfield is haunted by waking nightmares — a grandfather clock ticking in the walls, visions of her mother's cruelty. She seeks drugs from Eddie.

title: Vecna Takes Chrissy
summary: In Eddie's trailer, Chrissy is lifted into the air. Her bones snap one by one, her eyes go dark. Eddie watches in horror, then runs.

title: Eddie Runs
summary: Eddie flees the trailer in a panic, calling Dustin for help. The police find Chrissy's body. Eddie becomes the prime suspect — a satanic drug dealer, they say.

title: Nancy Investigates
summary: Nancy hears about Chrissy's death at the school newspaper and begins investigating. The pattern — snapped limbs, sunken eyes — matches no known cause of death.

title: Fred Benson Dies
summary: Nancy's colleague Fred Benson is cursed by Vecna — haunted by a past accident. He's found dead in the same gruesome manner as Chrissy. Two deaths, same pattern.

title: Robin Finds the Clue
summary: Robin discovers an old newspaper clipping about the Creel family murders in 1959 — a father who went mad and killed his own family. The connection to Vecna begins to form.

title: Eleven Can't Fight Back
summary: Without her powers, Eleven is bullied at school in California. A girl smashes an egg on her head. She can't fight back. She writes to Mike, pretending everything is fine.

title: The Byers House Raid
summary: Government agents storm the Byers' California home. Eleven uses her fury to stop a helicopter — but it's not enough. She's taken by Dr. Owens to the NINA facility.

title: Max Sees the Clock
summary: Max begins seeing Vecna's grandfather clock. At Billy's grave, she hears his voice. The curse has found her — grief and guilt are its doorways.

title: Vecna Takes Max
summary: Max is pulled into Vecna's mind — a dark, twisted version of her memories. She relives Billy's death, her own isolation, the Party falling apart. She begins to give up.

title: Running Up That Hill
summary: Dustin, Lucas, and Steve put headphones on Max. Kate Bush's "Running Up That Hill" floods her ears. The music cuts through Vecna's grip. Max runs — and breaks free.

title: Max Breaks Free
summary: Max tears through the red mental landscape, clawing her way back to reality. She gasps awake in the cemetery, alive. The spell is broken — for now.

title: Eleven Enters NINA
summary: Dr. Owens shows Eleven the NINA tank — a sensory deprivation chamber that lets her relive her suppressed memories from Hawkins Lab. She descends into the past.

title: Memories of the Lab
summary: Through NINA, Eleven relives her childhood at Hawkins Lab. She sees other children — 002, 008, the orderly who was kind to her. A memory she buried is surfacing.

title: The Power Returns
summary: As Eleven processes her suppressed trauma, her telekinetic power begins to resurface. She crushes the NINA tank's machinery. She's not powerless — she just forgot.

title: Diving into the Upside Down
summary: Steve dives into Lovers Lake and surfaces in the Upside Down. The group follows, discovering the dark mirror of Hawkins — and the trail leading to Vecna's lair.

title: Inside the Creel House
summary: In the Upside Down's version of the Creel House, Nancy and Robin find clues linking Vecna to the 1959 murders. The grandfather clock ticks. They're getting closer.

title: Young Henry Creel
summary: Through NINA, Eleven watches young Henry Creel move into the Creel house in 1959. He discovers spiders, telepathy, and the darkness within himself.

title: The Creel Murders
summary: Henry uses his powers to kill his mother and sister, framing his father Victor. The house fills with clock chimes and broken bodies. This was the first massacre.

title: Henry Becomes 001
summary: Dr. Brenner captures Henry and brands him 001 — the first. For twenty years, Brenner tries to replicate his power in other children, including Eleven.

title: The Massacre
summary: Henry — disguised as the friendly orderly — kills every child and staff member at Hawkins Lab. Only Eleven survives, overpowering him and casting him into the Upside Down.

title: Vecna Is Born
summary: Henry is struck by Eleven's power and hurled into the Upside Down. Lightning fuses with his flesh. He becomes Vecna — and begins building his dark kingdom.

title: Papa Returns
summary: Eleven's powers are back, but NINA is compromised. Dr. Brenner — Papa — is alive, working with Owens. He wants to complete Eleven's training. She must choose.

title: Brenner's End
summary: Military forces storm the NINA facility. Brenner is shot carrying Eleven to safety. He dies reaching for her. Papa is gone — and Eleven is finally free of him.

title: Eleven Goes to Hawkins
summary: With her powers fully restored, Eleven projects into Max's mind to save her from Vecna. Argyle drives the California crew toward Hawkins. The race is on.

title: The Piggyback Plan
summary: The group devises a three-pronged attack: the Hawkins crew fights Vecna's body at the Creel House, Eleven enters Max's mind, and Eddie creates a diversion in the Upside Down.

title: Eddie's Master of Puppets
summary: In the Upside Down, Eddie shreds Metallica's "Master of Puppets" on his guitar, drawing the Demobats away from the Creel House. Dustin watches from the gate.

title: Eddie's Sacrifice
summary: Eddie's guitar strings break. The Demobats swarm. He fights them with a trash can lid, buying every second he can. He dies in Dustin's arms. "I didn't run away this time."

title: Eleven vs. Vecna
summary: Inside Max's mind, Eleven confronts Vecna. He's stronger than before — but so is she. She fights for Max's life, for Hawkins, for everyone she's lost.

title: Vecna Is Hit
summary: Nancy, Steve, and Robin attack Vecna's physical form with Molotov cocktails and shotgun blasts. Eleven strikes from within. Vecna burns — but the gates keep opening.

title: Max's Heart Stops
summary: Vecna breaks Max's bones in the mind void. Lucas holds her body as her heart stops. Eleven screams — and restarts it with everything she has. Max lives. Barely.

title: The Gates Rip Hawkins Apart
summary: Four gates converge across Hawkins, tearing the earth apart. Ash falls like snow. The Upside Down bleeds into the real world. Hawkins is breaking.

title: Hawkins Falls Silent
summary: The gates close — or do they? Hawkins is quarantined. Max lies in a coma, her mind gone. Eleven reaches for her, but finds only silence. The battle is over. The war isn't.

title: Hawkins Under Quarantine
summary: Hawkins is a military zone. Armed patrols, razor wire, refugee camps. Dr. Kay leads the operation. The town that hid the Upside Down is now caged by it.

title: The Wheeler House Attack
summary: A Demogorgon crashes through the Wheeler home. Holly screams. The creature takes her through a gate — the same way Will was taken four years ago. History repeating.

title: Holly Is Gone
summary: The Wheeler family reels. Holly is gone — vanished into the Upside Down. Mike and Nancy stare at the hole in the wall. They know this horror. They've lived it before.

title: Eleven Searches for Hopper
summary: Eleven pushes deeper into the Upside Down, following a psychic thread. She finds Hopper — alive, scarred, surviving in the dark. He's been waiting.

title: Eleven Finds Hopper
summary: "Papa?" "Not even close." Hopper holds Eleven. She's taller now. He's thinner. But they're together. The Upside Down couldn't take everything.

title: Mr. Whatsit Revealed
summary: In the psychic realm, Holly's imaginary friend "Mr. Whatsit" reveals itself — it's Henry Creel. He's been whispering to her for years. The grooming is complete.

title: The Turnbow Trap
summary: The group sets a trap using Derek Turnbow as bait to draw out the Demogorgon. It's reckless, desperate, and the only plan they have left.

title: The Trap Springs
summary: The Demogorgon takes the bait. Steve swings his nail bat. The creature goes down — but it's just one. The Upside Down has many more.

title: Will's Powers Awaken
summary: Will feels the gates pulsing. He can sense the hive mind, see through the Upside Down's eyes. Four years of connection have given him power. He's not just a victim anymore.

title: Kali at the Military Base
summary: Hopper and Eleven find Kali imprisoned at the military base. She's been caught, experimented on. But her illusion powers are intact — and they're exactly what they need.

title: Vecna Takes the Children
summary: Vecna pulls more children into his psychic realm, building an army of minds. Holly watches helplessly. She's no longer a guest — she's a prisoner.

title: Inside Henry's Mind
summary: Max and Holly navigate Henry Creel's memories — his spider obsession, his mother's cruelty, the moment he first killed. Understanding the monster is the first step to defeating him.

title: The Demogorgon Rises
summary: Using the exotic matter sphere, the group reanimates a Demogorgon — turning the Upside Down's own weapon against it. Dustin grins. "Science rules."

title: The Exotic Matter Sphere
summary: Dustin discovers the exotic matter sphere — a concentrated fragment of Upside Down energy. It could close the gates forever. Or tear them wide open.

title: The Detonation
summary: The exotic matter detonates. The blast tears new pathways between dimensions, destabilizing every gate in Hawkins. The Upside Down bleeds through faster than ever.

title: Demodogs at the Hospital
summary: Demodogs swarm Hawkins Memorial Hospital. Steve and Robin fight to protect the patients. The nail bat swings. Robin fires a shotgun. They hold the line.

title: Escape from the Psychic Realm
summary: Will opens a psychic bridge from outside. Max pushes Holly through it, then tears herself free. They emerge gasping, changed. The realm is behind them.

title: Will Comes Out
summary: Will tells Mike who he really is. No fanfare, no drama — just two friends on a porch. Mike hugs him. "I know." The world is ending, and Will is finally free.

title: The Bridge to the Abyss
summary: Dustin pieces it together: the Upside Down isn't the source — it's a bridge. Beyond it lies the Abyss, a dimension of pure shadow. The Mind Flayer doesn't live in Hawkins. It lives there.

title: Henry's Army
summary: Henry manipulates the kidnapped children, weaving their minds into his hive. He's building something — not just an army, but a conduit. A way to bring the Abyss into Hawkins.

title: The Mind Flayer Rises
summary: The Mind Flayer manifests physically — a towering kaiju of shadow and vine that rises over Hawkins. The sky goes dark. This is the endgame.

title: Kali's Illusion
summary: Kali projects massive illusions — a false army, a fake Eleven — confusing the Mind Flayer. The effort burns through her. She collapses. But she bought them time.

title: Kali's Sacrifice
summary: Kali dies in Eleven's arms. Her last words: "Finish it, little sister." The illusion fades. But the opening it created is real. Eleven faces the Mind Flayer alone.

title: Eleven vs. Henry
summary: Will bridges their psychic link. Eleven channels everything — every loss, every friend, every moment of love — and strikes Henry Creel. He shatters. The Mind Flayer dissolves. It's over.

title: The Rightside Up
summary: Eighteen months later. Hawkins is rebuilding. The Party plays D&D in Mike's basement one last time. Eleven smiles. The gates are closed. The world is, at last, right-side up.
